name: nexaclaude-code-workspace
description: A complete, opinionated Claude Code workspace — blocking hooks, a WIP=1 pipeline, auto-loading skills, and a multi-vendor council.
_comment: NO DEPENDENCIES, AND THAT IS A FEATURE. Every script here is plain Node, so a fresh
clone runs the whole suite with no install step and nothing to audit. The engineering
baseline a PRODUCT repo needs — linter, formatter, type checking — ships as templates
under templates/engineering-baseline/ instead, because those tools belong to the code
being written, not to the process writing it.
This file exists mostly so that `npm run` works at all: the docs referenced npm scripts
for weeks while there was no package.json, which meant the first command a new user

scripts.gate: npm run secrets && npm run leakage && npm run check && npm test
